name: MADISON
title: A more considered kind of grandeur.
description: Eight MARINER catalogue pieces become an open living-gallery study: three deeply upholstered sofas, marble-topped tables, a rounded TV cabinet and two slender consoles. Glossy walnut burl veneer, chased bronze details and taupe textiles echo the supplied classic reference.
